label: Labor, immigration, and workforce-mobility estate
domain: employment, public service, visas, labor-condition filings, workforce programs, unions, layoffs, payroll, and personnel mobility
scope: Employer and occupational denominators, H-1B and labor-condition filings, permanent-labor certifications, public payroll and appointments, union and labor-organization filings, workforce grants, WARN notices, layoffs, hiring, job classifications, and personnel transitions. The estate separates authorized position, filing, employment, appointment, compensation, and later role.

asset_refs.role: bounded frontier survey and acquisition preparation

boundary: A visa or labor filing is not proof a named person worked in a position. Employment sequence, public service, and later corporate role do not establish knowledge transfer or influence.

next_acquisition.operation: join exact employers, positions, filings, payroll, appointments, layoffs, unions, and personnel transitions while retaining aggregate-only limits
next_acquisition.decisive_output: employer- and position-level workforce ledger with filing, occupation, location, dates, compensation, appointment, separation, and explicit aggregate or no-match limits
source_routes: USCIS EB-5 regional centers and program records
